Subject: Urgent: temporary quota increase for weekend promo

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from the operations team – we have a weekend flash promotion that will drive a large spike in product description generation and recommendation embeddings. Our current quota will be exhausted in ~36 hours if traffic trends continue.

Can Redwood provide a short-run quota bridge (approx +3x for 72 hours) and confirm pricing for that window? We may have a signed PO coming but procurement needs the outline to approve the L4 weekend ops.

- Cost for a 72-hour 3x quota extension (billable or credited against a later true-up)
- Any discount if we commit to convert a portion of this uplift into a monthly commit (e.g., 20% of uplift becomes baseline for 6 months)

We need a rapid yes/no so we can proceed with the internal launch.

Thanks,

Samir — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the promo. We can support a short 72-hour runway with the following commercial structure:

1) Short-run quota bridge: +3x baseline for 72 hours (activation within 2 hours of approval).
2) Pricing: consumption during the bridge billed at the standard pay-as-you-go rate but eligible for a 40% retroactive credit if Atlas converts >=20% of the bridged consumption into a 6-month reserved commit within 14 days of the event.
3) If Atlas does not convert, consumption remains billable with a one-time 10% discount applied to the bridge invoice as a courtesy.
4) SLA: we'll prioritize capacity routing to avoid soft-limits; we'll provide a transient throttling policy only if other higher-tiers are saturated.

I've attached a one-page bridging quote and a short SLA exception form for procurement. If this looks good, reply with an approval and the contact for your PO (procurement@atlas-retail.com is fine).

Next steps I propose:
- Samir confirms approval to proceed (email reply)
- Procurement/PO shared or we start immediate chargeable activation (we can issue credit later if conversion happens)
- Ben will standby for any technical ops routing changes

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through timing.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
